company.name: Kebra
company.shortDescription: Kebra develops AI software that automates field-service documentation and back-office workflows.
company.description: Kebra provides AI software for field service and residential services companies. Its agents capture technician audio, notes, images, and job details, then turn that information into service records, customer communications, parts orders, billing updates, and warranty claims. The platform connects field information with systems such as service-management, accounting, supplier, email, messaging, and warranty portals. Kebra also provides a customer-specific Company Brain that organizes authorized business information for retrieval and workflow automation.

productsAndServices.description: AI software that captures field-service job information and automates documentation, claims, parts, billing, and customer follow-up.
